children: The partnership will build a nationwide sales and distribution network for Huwel’s compact Cubo RT-PCR platform across hospitals, labs and other healthcare facilities

Avio Smart Market Stack (ASMS), formerly Bartronics India , and Huwel Lifesciences are expanding their collaboration to build a nationwide commercialisation platform for Cubo, Huwel’s ultra-compact RT-PCR system.

The partnership will focus on expanding access to molecular diagnostics across India’s private healthcare sector, including hospitals, diagnostic centres, research institutions and smaller healthcare facilities.

As part of the initiative, the companies plan to establish a dedicated sales and distribution infrastructure, including senior sales leadership, specialised sales teams and strategic channel partnerships. The initial focus will be on Cubo, with plans to create opportunities for the wider commercialisation of Huwel’s molecular diagnostics portfolio.
N Vidhya Sagar Reddy, Managing Director, ASMS, said the collaboration would focus on developing the commercial infrastructure needed to expand access to molecular diagnostic technologies.

“Cubo’s compact format creates an opportunity to bring RT-PCR capabilities closer to hospitals, laboratories and other healthcare providers, including those outside the traditional centralised laboratory ecosystem. Our focus will be on building the sales leadership, distribution network and market coverage required to support its adoption at scale across India,” he said.

Cubo is designed to enable RT-PCR testing in decentralised healthcare settings, potentially reducing reliance on large centralised laboratories. Its compact format is intended to support deployment across healthcare facilities in metropolitan areas as well as Tier-II and Tier-III cities.

The proposed commercial strategy will target private hospitals, diagnostic chains, independent laboratories, medical colleges, research institutions and other healthcare establishments. The planned sales organisation will combine direct sales with channel partnerships and provide product demonstrations, installation support and customer engagement.

The companies also plan to develop an ecosystem around the platform, including compatible molecular assays and consumables for recurring testing requirements. Huwel’s broader molecular diagnostics capabilities could allow Cubo installations to support multiple testing applications.

The expanded collaboration shifts the focus from product and institutional opportunities towards building a broader commercial platform for Huwel’s molecular diagnostics portfolio. For ASMS, the partnership is expected to strengthen its presence in healthcare and diagnostics, while Huwel gains additional sales and distribution capabilities for its products.
The companies aim to use the planned sales leadership, distribution partnerships and nationwide market coverage to expand the availability of compact molecular diagnostic technologies across India.
